messages:
jen: Quick triage note — customer reporting intermittent 502s in the web console when saving templates. Need HAR + console logs + a curl repro if possible. Please follow these steps and attach the bundle to the ticket.

mike: Thanks Jen. Short checklist I usually ask for:
- reproduce in Chrome (Incognito if auth is flaky)
- open DevTools -> Network, check 'Preserve log'
- check Console for stack traces / CORS errors
- right-click the failing request -> Save all as HAR with content

jen: Adding a couple of extras to avoid common pitfalls:
- Disable cache in DevTools while reproducing (Network -> Disable cache)
- If the error happens during a redirect or an XHR, right-click the specific request -> Copy -> Copy as cURL
- Look for response headers named `x-request-id`, `x-rw-trace`, or `x-rw-request` and include those values in the ticket

lisa: If the customer can't share raw HAR (PII), ask them to redact tokens before sending. Example quick scrub for curl lines (remove Authorization header):

```
# paste cURL into a file then run
sed -E 's/-H "Authorization: [^"]+"/-H "Authorization: REDACTED"/g' original_curl.sh > scrubbed_curl.sh
```

mike: If they want a curl repro from the HAR: they can right-click the request -> Copy -> Copy as cURL (cmd). Then replace any session cookie / bearer token with REDACTED and run locally. Example minimal curl for a JSON POST:

```
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/some/endpoint' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  --data-raw '{"template":"hello"}'
```

jen: Two gotchas we've seen:
1) HAR missing response body if the request was fetched from the cache — ask them to reproduce with 'Disable cache' on.
2) Single-page-apps can replay requests with stale cookies. Repro in Incognito (no extensions) helps isolate.

deploy-bot: [deploy] production/webapp v2.14.6 deployed at 2026-03-17T08:45:10Z :rocket:

lisa: Also ask them to upload the HAR to the support ticket or paste a temporary S3 link. If they prefer Slack, tell them to DM me and I'll forward into the ticket. Remind them to include the exact local time they reproduced and the user email (if safe to share).

mike: If HAR is too big / truncated: ask for a trimmed capture — start recording, reproduce the single failing action, stop, then Save as HAR. That keeps the file small and focused.

jen: Final template to paste to customer (short):

```
Hi — thanks for the report. To help us reproduce please:
1) Open Chrome (Incognito) -> DevTools -> Network -> check 'Preserve log' and 'Disable cache'
2) Reproduce the failure
3) Right-click -> Save all as HAR with content and include any console errors
4) Right-click failing request -> Copy -> Copy as cURL, redact tokens and attach
5) Share the values of any `x-request-id` or `x-rw-*` headers from the response

Upload the HAR + scrubbed curl to the ticket or DM @lisa on Slack.
```

jen: pinging @mike for any extra SRE notes before I send.

mike: Looks good. If we see consistent 502s with `x-rw-request` present, we'll trace it on ingestion side. Otherwise ask for full HAR + timeline. :+1:

lisa: I'll send the template and offer a short screenshare if customer struggles to produce the HAR.
